popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: King of Phthia, son of Actor: he purifies Peleus, gives him Antigone and a third of the realm, then dies by Peleus' spear in the Calydonian hunt — not the centaur or Geryon's herdsman of the same name.

popCulture.title: Eurytion (king of Phthia)
popCulture.description: Phthian king who hosted the exiled Peleus — carefully distinct from Eurytion the centaur.
